* Six members of the British [[Royal Military Police]] are killed, in an attack in [[Majar al-Kabir]], a village near the town of [[Amarah]] in [[Iraq]]. Eight others are wounded in two separate [[ambush]]es.<ref>{{cite news |author=Jamie Wilson |author2=Richard Norton-Taylor |author3=Michael White |author4=Michael Howard |url=http://www.guardian.co.uk/Iraq/Story/0,2763,984500,00.html |title=Six British soldiers dead, eight hurt as a fragile peace fractures |department=World news |publisher=The Guardian |date= |accessdate=2015-12-22}}</ref>
* A [[2003 South Dakota tornado outbreak#Manchester, South Dakota|violent tornado]], rated F4 on the [[Fujita scale]], annihilates the tiny town of [[Manchester, South Dakota]]. Manchester was never rebuilt and is now a "ghost town".<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://tornadoarchive.com/home/ |title=Tornado Archive - Home |website=TornadoArchive |publisher=TornadoArchive}}</ref>
